summary: BioXcel Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a Tenth Amendment to its Credit Agreement with Oaktree-led lenders, effective July 3, 2026. The amendment capitalizes unpaid interest through June 30, 2026, defers a $9.0M principal-plus-interest payment from June 30 to July 31, 2026, and reduces the minimum liquidity covenant from $12.5M to $7.5M. The company must by July 31, 2026, either sign a repayment-triggering transaction (sale/business combination) or an alternative capital solution acceptable to lenders. A special board committee with exclusive authority over sale, restructuring or bankruptcy processes was established. Watch for imminent distress-driven sale, equity raise or in-court filing before the July 31 deadline.
